# Privacy and Data Governance

- Inventory/classify data; map purpose, lawful basis/consent, controller/processor, region, transfer, retention, export, deletion, and subprocessor.
- Maintain a jurisdiction matrix, records of processing, representative/DPO/DPIA screening, SCC/IDTA/TIA records, and counsel disposition.
- Support access, correction, deletion, export, authorized agents, appeals, nondiscrimination, sale/share/targeted-ad/profile controls, GPC, suppression, and request metrics.
- Version consent receipts and propagate withdrawal/purpose changes.
- Define log/telemetry redaction, legal holds, processor monitoring, breach SLAs, deletion evidence, and tested exit.
- Global baseline does not replace jurisdiction-specific professional review.
